card.name: Words before drug-interaction targets
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction or mechanism sentences just before the thing acted on, such as 'inhibitor' in 'substrate and inhibitor of CYP3A4', 'to' after 'potential', or 'muscles' before 'of the uterus'.

modes.label: Enzyme roles
modes.description: The word 'inhibitor' or 'substrate' (or a comma in an enzyme list) in statements about CYP or transporter enzymes.

modes.label: Potential to affect
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'has the potential' in interaction statements.

modes.label: Body part in mechanism
modes.description: A body-part noun in a plain explanation of how something acts on the body.
modes.example: a chemical that causes the<< muscles>> of the uterus to contract
